title: The Bag of Shell Pasta
youtube_title: The Bag of Shell Pasta | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Yael sees that a bag of shell pasta poured into two pots will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Yael makes a smaller, even share so Wynn is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
